approach: Static recompilation with 3dsrecomp, run on the Zakuro 3DS runtime. The launcher builds it from the own copy of the game of the player.
notes: 3D at up to 8 times the resolution of the console, battles and cutscenes at 60 FPS with frame interpolation, a 16:9 mode, play on the top screen alone with the bottom screen on demand, a Three Houses style battle display, and feet for every character model. Original mode plays the game as the console does.
